title: No test proves another gym's member cannot send a workout report, add workout dates, or leave a workout offer for this gym
what: Three member calls take an id that belongs to the gym: sending the workout report the desk asked for, adding workout dates to the gym's offer, and leaving the offer. Reading the server code, each one only acts on a record of the member's own gym (and own person), so no leak was found. But the database tests only ever call these three with the member's own key and own gym's ids; none tries another gym's member, unlike the other member calls (plan requests, questions, messages, mate profiles, check-in), which do have such a test. A later change could drop the gym check without any test failing.
expected: Each of the three has a database test where a member of another gym (and another member of the same gym) names this gym's request or offer and is refused.
how_often: no known trigger today; only if a later change breaks the check
fix_line: Add a refusal test for another gym's member on each of the three calls

items.reason: 65 database functions are called from this area, all as the not-signed-in app role with the public app key. 63 are in the live catalog, each a key-checking function: 57 take the member key, staff_sign_out a staff session key; gym_preview and member_join take the gym's join code (guessable, already FN-L3-server-database-1-01); member_find_gyms and phone_sign_in_find take a WhatsApp proof; staff_sign_in takes mobile and PIN (server tries and lock). member_gym_pack and member_join_day are not in the live catalog (their files say not applied). Three payment routes on MettleUp's web server (mine, member-check, shop) take the member key; the cross-member test gap there is already FN-L3-server-panel-worker-03.

Apps-cannot-read variant: the phone code here reads no table directly (no table call in the area, only functions). Live catalog: row rules on for every table, and the only 10 rules belong to signed-in panel users or storage; none lets the not-signed-in app role read a gym table. security.sql reads every table as that role and expects nothing (its seed is thin, already FN-L3-server-hq-gate-workers-04). Through the functions, another gym or member is refused by a test for: shop products and orders, messages, plan requests, report requests (answer), offers (join), mate profiles, trainer questions, member messages, check-in, push addresses. Key-only reads (hours, busy, board, plans, workout of the day, measurements, diet) take no outside id.
Rule applied: no live cross-gym attempt was run; only code, tests and the catalog were read.
No key pattern hit in this area; the area never holds a key, it calls through the shared app client outside the area.
No AI or paid-service key in this area; it sends only the member's own gym key to MettleUp's own server and database.

The member side has no sign-in, only the gym member key until the member leaves. The hidden staff door uses the admin sign-in (5 wrong PINs lock 15 minutes, tested) and signs the session out at once without keeping its key; the find-my-gym search has a tries limit (tested).

Typed text (join name, questions, messages, plan notes) goes as function arguments, never built into a query, and the phone shows it as plain text. The workout report text is not made spreadsheet-safe on the phone, but the panel re-writes it safely before the desk opens it.
The only upload is the workout report text: the server checks its header and counts and refuses over 3 MB. No picture or file goes to storage from this area.

Invite links /j/CODE carry the gym's join code, which can be found by trying (already FN-L3-server-database-1-01). Check-in poster codes only work for a member of that gym (tested). Trainer video links open only YouTube https links.

This area imports only react, react-native, zustand, AsyncStorage, expo-constants, expo-task-manager and expo-background-task; none has an alert in the scan. The phone's spreadsheet library alerts belong to the workout import, outside this area.
